name: statewright
description: State machine workflow enforcement — controls which tools your agent can use in each phase.

interface.shortDescription: State machine guardrails — per-state tool enforcement for coding workflows.
interface.longDescription: Statewright enforces state-machine workflows for Codex: each phase exposes only the permitted tools, injects the active state context, and steers autonomous work through completion.
defaultPrompt: Start a Statewright workflow and continue autonomously until it reaches a final state.
